These steps build FlawBOT from source and run it on a Linux machine such as a Raspberry Pi (64-bit OS). They work the same on any other machine with the .NET runtime. Download the latest FlawBOT source code. Install the .NET 10 SDK on the machine you'll build on. Modify the included src/FlawBOT/Resources/config.json file with your API tokens. Build and publish the bot. dotnet publish src/FlawBOT/FlawBOT.csproj -c Release -o publish Update your Raspberry Pi to the latest version. sudo apt-get update -y sudo apt-get upgrade -y Copy the contents of the publish folder to the Raspberry Pi. Install the .NET 10 runtime on the Raspberry Pi. curl -sSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash /dev/stdin --channel 10.0 --runtime dotnet echo 'export DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/.dotnet' >> ~/.bashrc echo 'export PATH=$PATH:$HOME/.dotnet' >> ~/.bashrc source ~/.bashrc Navigate to where you've copied your FlawBOT files and start the bot. dotnet FlawBOT.dll FlawBOT shuts down cleanly when it receives Ctrl+C or SIGTERM, so it can be run as a systemd service or in a container.

In the Discord Developer Portal, invite the bot with the bot and applications.commands scopes. FlawBOT uses slash commands only, so the Message Content Intent is not needed. Enable the Server Members Intent if you want to use /role inrole.

dotnet test src/FlawBOT.sln This runs the offline unit tests. Tests that call the real APIs are in the Live category and are skipped by default. To run them, add your tokens to config.json or set FLAWBOT_TOKEN_<NAME> environment variables (for example FLAWBOT_TOKEN_NASA), then run: dotnet test src/FlawBOT.sln -- NUnit.Where="cat == Live" Live tests for APIs without a configured token are skipped.

Lavalink is a standalone audio sending node. It's required to use FlawBOT's music commands. FlawBOT 5.0 uses Lavalink v4. Older Lavalink v3 servers are no longer supported. Install Java 17 or newer. Download Lavalink.jar from the latest Lavalink v4 release. Put Lavalink.jar in the same folder as the application.yml file that ships with FlawBOT (in the Resources folder). Open application.yml and change address to the IP of the machine you'll be running Lavalink from. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on every network interface. Also change the password. server: # REST and WS server port: 2333 address: 192.168.2.38 lavalink: server: password: "youshallnotpass" Open config.json and change Address, Port and Password to match the values set in Step 4. Set Enabled to true. "Lavalink": { "Enabled": true, "Address": "192.168.2.38", "Port": 2333, "Password": "youshallnotpass" } Open the command prompt in that folder and start Lavalink by entering: java -jar Lavalink.jar Start FlawBOT. The /music commands are only registered when Lavalink is enabled.

YouTube support in Lavalink v4 is provided by the youtube-source plugin. The included application.yml already enables it and disables Lavalink's old built-in YouTube source. Lavalink downloads the plugin automatically on first start. YouTube changes often, so if playback stops working, update the plugin version in application.yml to the latest release and restart Lavalink: lavalink: plugins: - dependency: "dev.lavalink.youtube:youtube-plugin:1.18.2" note Lavalink must be running before you use any music command. If FlawBOT can't connect, it logs "Exception occurred when connecting the lavalink node." and the other commands keep working.
Commands for directly interacting with FlawBOT.
Returns basic information about FlawBOT. /bot info
Removes FlawBOT from the server. Requires administrative permissions on the server. /bot leave
Pings the active FlawBOT instance. /bot ping
Returns the uptime of the active FlawBOT instance. /bot uptime
Owner Only. Changes FlawBOT's activity. /bot activity Team Fortress 2
Owner Only. Changes FlawBOT's avatar. /bot avatar https://frinkiac.com/img/S03E20/301341.jpg
Owner Only. Changes FlawBOT's nickname on the current server. Leave empty to reset it. /bot nickname FlowBOT
Owner Only. Changes FlawBOT's status to Online, Idle, Do Not Disturb or Invisible. /bot status Idle
Removes up to 100 messages from the current server channel. Messages older than two weeks cannot be bulk-deleted by Discord and are skipped. /channel clean 10
Returns information about a server channel. /channel info #text
Creates a new channel category. /channel new-category Welcome
Creates a new text channel. Spaces are replaced with dashes. /channel new-text general-chat
Creates a new voice channel. /channel new-voice Music Room
Changes the server channel name. /channel rename #text newtext
Changes the server channel topic. /channel topic Watermelon picking
Commands for interacting with the Urban Dictionary API.
Returns a definition for a word or phrase from Urban Dictionary. Leave the query empty for a random word. /define computers
Commands for interacting with the Imgur API.
Returns a queried image from Imgur. /imgur cats
Asks the magic 8-ball a question. /ask Am I lucky?
Returns a random cat fact and image. /cat
Commands for playing audio in voice channels using Lavalink. note Music commands are only registered when Lavalink is enabled in config.json. Playing a new track replaces the current one.
Returns the current audio track information. /music info
Plays audio from a URL or search query. Plain text is searched on YouTube. /music play https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4JkIs37a2JE /music play night of fire
Stops audio playback and leave the voice channel. /music stop
Changes audio playback volume between 0% and 100%. Defaults to 100%. /music volume 50
Commands for interacting with the NASA API.
Returns the Picture of the Day from NASA. /nasa
Commands for interacting with the News API.
Commands for interacting with Nintendo game APIs.
Returns information about an Amiibo figurine or card. /amiibo luigi
Commands for interacting with the OMDB API.
Returns a movie or TV show from OMDB. /omdb mission impossible
Commands for interacting with the Reddit RSS Feed.
Returns hot-topics from Reddit for a given subreddit. /reddit hot tf2
Returns new-topics from Reddit for a given subreddit. /reddit new tf2
Returns top-topics from Reddit for a given subreddit. /reddit top tf2
Creates a new server role. /role create admin
Deletes a server role. /role delete admin
Returns server role information. /role info admin

Returns list of users in a given role. note Listing server members requires the Server Members Intent to be enabled for your bot in the Discord Developer Portal (Bot > Privileged Gateway Intents). /role inrole admin
Toggles whether the role can be mentioned by others. /role mention admin
Commands for managing the Discord server.
Changes the server avatar. Requires the Manage Server permission. The image must be a PNG, JPG or GIF under 10MB. /server avatar https://frinkiac.com/img/S03E20/301341.jpg
Changes the name of the server. Requires the Manage Server permission. /server rename Cool Discord Server
Commands for interacting with the Speedrun.com API.
Returns game information from Speedrun.com /speedrun Donkey Kong 64
Commands for interacting with the Steam API.
Formats a server connection string, with an optional password, into a link. /steam connect 192.168.0.200:27015 /steam connect 192.168.0.200:27015; password hello
Returns information on a Steam game. Accepts a game name or app ID. /steam game Team Fortress 2
Returns information on a Steam user. Accepts a custom URL name, a 64-bit Steam ID or a profile link. /steam user criticalflaw /steam user 76561197960287930
Commands for interacting with Frinkiac and Morbotron.
Returns a random Simpsons episode GIF. /simpsons
Returns a random Futurama episode GIF. /futurama
Commands for interacting with the Teamwork.TF API for Team Fortress 2.
Returns a community creator profile from teamwork.tf /tf2 creator criticalflaw
Returns an item from the latest TF2 item schema. Requires a Steam API token. /tf2 item natasha
Returns map information from teamwork.tf /tf2 map pl_upward
Returns the latest news article from teamwork.tf. Optionally pass a page number for older posts. /tf2 news /tf2 news 2
Returns a game server with given ip address. /tf2 search 164.132.233.16
Returns a list of servers for a given game-mode. /tf2 server payload
Returns a curated list of servers. /tf2 server-list
Returns server user's profile picture. Defaults to your own. /user avatar @CriticalFlaw
Bans a server user for a given day duration and reason. /user ban @CriticalFlaw 7 Spammer
Returns server user's information. Defaults to your own. /user info @CriticalFlaw
Unbans a user from the server, using their Discord user ID. /user unban 339833029013012483
Commands for interacting with the WeatherStack API.
Returns weather information for a given location. /weather toronto
Commands for interacting with the YouTube API.
Returns a list of queried YouTube channels. /youtube channel Jerma2nd
Returns a list of queried YouTube playlists. /youtube playlist gmod
Returns the first YouTube search result. /youtube search tf2
Returns a list of queried YouTube videos. /youtube video tf2
Commands for interacting with the Wikipedia API.
Returns articles found on Wikipedia. /wikipedia discord
Commands for interacting with the Twitch API.
Returns Twitch stream information, if online. /twitch jerma985

To get the most out of FlawBOT's commands, modify the included config.json file with the API tokens below. Only the Discord token is required. Commands whose token is missing reply with "No results found." Token Used by Notes Discord Everything Required. The bot token from the Bot page of your application. Imgur /imgur The application's Client ID. NASA /nasa Optional. Uses NASA's rate-limited DEMO_KEY when empty. NewsAPI /news OMDB /omdb Pokemon /pokemon Optional. Raises the Pokémon TCG API rate limit. Steam /steam, /tf2 item, /tf2 creator /steam game also works without a token. Teamwork.TF /tf2 Twitch /twitch Twitch is the Client ID and TwitchAccess is an app access token. Weather /weather Weatherstack access key. YouTube /youtube YouTube Data API v3 key. { "Name": "FlawBOT", "ShardCount": 1, "Lavalink": { "Enabled": false, "Address": "127.0.0.1", "Port": 2333, "Password": "youshallnotpass" }, "Tokens": { "Discord": "MzM5OD123435EyNDgz.Gh3bSD.ryJQ1--BJDn_4sWtXSX345SdFUbb49Y", "Steam": "CB63523458CC09AB615E4EC8", "Imgur": "b1ab10234d2c6", "Pokemon": "e8494d53-a6f9-4c8b-234-e75f8b84b37c", "OMDB": "76c8889f", "Twitch": "ylc3xvh9mbte456s5zqtxyb2", "TwitchAccess": "ylc3xvh9mbtemvf6546s5zqtxyb2", "NASA": "4al2olXC60FxVhBpA4563bkEml8XKtl8e", "TeamworkTF": "CAYpI456ZcmBd61htfiePyoVzHJ", "News": "b7c080f4bf6a4e939c456e01b4d", "Weather": "3fb7a7791bd456b14ae756fbc3ac4c", "YouTube": "AIzaSyCghVt456_nnBVrxhEEot0" } } note Twitch app access tokens expire after about 60 days. Generate a new one with the client credentials flow when /twitch stops returning results.

Install the .NET 10 Runtime. Download the latest version of flawbot.zip. Extract downloaded file contents into a separate folder. Modify the included Resources/config.json file with your API tokens. Open the command prompt and start the bot by entering: dotnet FlawBOT.dll To use the music commands, also set up Lavalink.

The following is a list of modules included with the latest version of FlawBOT. Bot - Basic commands for interacting directly with the bot. Channel - Commands for managing server channels. Dictionary - Commands for interacting with the Urban Dictionary API. Imgur - Commands for interacting with the Imgur API. Misc - Miscellaneous bot interaction commands. Music - Have the bot play music in a voice channel. NASA - Commands for interacting with the NASA API. News - Commands for interacting with the News API. Nintendo - Commands for interacting with the Nintendo game APIs. OMDB - Commands for interacting with the OMDB API. Reddit - Commands for interacting with the Reddit RSS feeds. Role - Commands for managing server roles. Server - Commands for managing the Discord server. Simpsons - Commands for interacting with Frinkiac and Morbotron. Speedrun - Commands for interacting with the Speedrun.com API. Steam - Commands for interacting with the Steam API. Team Fortress 2 - Commands for interacting with the Teamwork.TF API for TF2. User - Commands for managing server users. Weather - Commands for interacting with the WeatherStack API. Wikipedia - Commands for interacting with the Wikipedia API. YouTube - Commands for interacting with the YouTube API.
